title: AudioCaps snapshot
description: The result of one probe. Contains only what the scope asked for.

generation.description: Generation number; increases with each new snapshot from the same probe context.

taken_at_ms.description: When the probe ran, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch (capture time for fixtures).

scope.description: The scope that was asked for.

redaction.description: Whether sensitive values have been redacted, and how.

layers.description: System-wide availability of each layer in scope.

routing.description: Routing of the default device, when the routing field group is in scope.

endpoints.description: Endpoints in scope, sorted by id.

SnapshotSource.description: What a snapshot was taken from.

ProbeScope.description:
What a probe may read and report. Build it with [`ProbeScope::nothing`] and the `with_*`
methods, or start from [`ProbeScope::everything`].

access_paths.description: Access paths to compute effective sets and path reports for.
